post.description: Create a new user account and store (SaaS onboarding). Automatically creates a new pending store using the required `store_name`, assigns the registering user the `admin` role for that store, and binds the user to its `store_id`. The store remains inactive until verified by a superadmin.

get.summary:
GetSettings returns the current store's settings (defaults when the
store has not customized them yet).

put.summary: UpdateSettings saves the current store's settings (upsert).
UpdateStoreInfo saves the store's address & phone.
put.description: The store name is identity and stays read-only. Only admin & manager can change store info.

store_name.description: Name of the store to create for the registering user (required for SaaS onboarding). The store is created inactive/pending until verified by a superadmin, and the registering user is assigned the admin role for it.

id.description: SKU ID (empty = create new, non-empty = update existing)
